title: Word and Cowork: legal plugins for Microsoft 365 Copilot add legal skills
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft's notice and documentation support the rollout, defaults, licensing and separate Word and Cowork controls, including the preview Graph operations. Minor corrections concern checklist controls missing from the table and a citation for the separate GCC roadmap item.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; rendered table; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The Word policy is reached in Microsoft 365 Apps admin center through Customization > Policy Management > Policy configurations > Create > Start with the basics > Choose the scope > Configure Settings > Legal Skills in M365 Copilot in Word.
claims.quote: Under Customization, select Policy Management. On the Policy configurations page, select Create. On the Configure Settings page, select the policies that you want to include in the policy configuration.

claims.claim: At November 2026, Microsoft Learn documents no PowerShell or Graph operation for the Cloud Policy configuration.
claims.quote: Searched: Cloud Policy service Microsoft 365 policy configuration PowerShell Microsoft Graph API Legal Skills Word; "Cloud Policy" "Graph" "policy" API configuration; "Cloud Policy" "PowerShell" configuration. Read overview-cloud-policy and API/cmdlet search excerpts; no configuration operation.

claims.claim: Cloud Policy configurations can target all users or specific Microsoft Entra groups.

claims.claim: Word and Cowork legal plugins are managed separately in different admin centres; neither plugin's stated control governs the other.
claims.quote: Two legal plugins are available: one for Copilot in Word and one for Copilot Cowork. Each is managed differently.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; rendered table; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > Tools > plugin > Users > Block blocks the Cowork plugin for all tenant users.
claims.quote: select Agents > Tools. Find the plugin you want to manage and go to the Users tab. ... Select Block: No users in your tenant can access the plugin.

claims.claim: POST /beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block blocks a Copilot package to prevent its usage.
claims.quote:
Block a Copilot package to prevent its usage.
POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block

claims.where: controls[2].ui; rendered table; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > Tools > plugin > Users > Available to specific users or groups limits visibility to selected users or security groups.
claims.quote: select Agents > Tools. Find the plugin you want to manage and go to the Users tab. ... Available to specific users or groups: Only the users or security groups you specify can view the plugin.

claims.claim: PATCH /beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id} updates availability using allowedUsersAndGroups and required availableTo, with allowedForSome for a selected audience.

PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}
allowedUsersAndGroups ... Users/groups for whom the package is available.
availableTo ... Required if updating allowedUsersAndGroups.
